content.title: Return Reason Form
content.description: Please select the reason for your return. We're here to help!

reason_codes.label: I didn't quite get the sizing right.

sub_reasons.label: The item was too small for me.
The item was too large for me.
I thought the item would run true to size, but it's smaller than expected.
I thought the item would run true to size, but it's bigger than expected.

reason_codes.label: The fabric quality didn't meet my expectations.

sub_reasons.label: The item has pilling or snagging issues.
The item shrunk after washing.
The item is fraying or coming apart at the seams.
The texture of the item is uncomfortable or unpleasant to wear.

reason_codes.label: The colour didn't match my expectations.

sub_reasons.label: The colour of the item doesn't match the description online.
The colour of the item is a different shade than expected.
The dye used in the item is inconsistent or uneven.

reason_codes.label: The style or design didn't quite work for me.

sub_reasons.label: The item doesn't flatter my figure.
The silhouette of the item is uncomfortable or unflattering.
The construction of the item is poor quality or not well-made.

reason_codes.label: The fit didn't quite work for me.

sub_reasons.label: The item is too tight and uncomfortable to wear.
The item is too loose and doesn't fit well.
The cut of the item is unflattering or not well-designed.

reason_codes.label: The material didn't meet my expectations.

sub_reasons.label: The item is not made from sustainable materials.
The item is not eco-friendly or environmentally responsible.
The item is not cruelty-free or uses animal products.

reason_codes.label: There was an issue with delivery or shipping.

sub_reasons.label: The item arrived late or after the expected delivery date.
The item was damaged during shipping or arrival.
An item was missing from my order.

deliverables.content:
# Weekly Returns Summary — Birdsong London

Subject: Your weekly returns snapshot

Hi team,

Here is this week's returns-reason breakdown:

- Top return reason: {{top_reason}} ({{top_reason_pct}}% of returns)
- Total returns this week: {{total_returns}}
- Week-over-week change: {{wow_change}}

Recommended action: review whether {{top_reason}} points to a sizing, description, or quality fix on the affected product(s).

— Generated by AIYYARY
